# Findings

> Out-of-scope findings from `sdd` missions. Never divert the mission to fix one; never lose it.
> One entry, about six lines: what, the anchor, why it matters, the direction, who found it.
> The long analysis belongs in the handoff of the mission cited.
>
> Format:
>
> ```md
> - [ ] <what> — `file:line` — <why it matters> — found by `<agent>` in mission `<slug>` (YYYY-MM-DD)
> ```
>
> Closed is DELETED, never archived: an entry marked `RESOLVED by <hash>` stays here only until
> the PR citing that evidence is merged, then leaves the file. Durable memory already exists in
> `git log -S`, in the handoffs, and in the hash the entry itself quotes. Delete on the artifact
> — `git merge-base --is-ancestor <hash> <base>` — never on a PR label.
